integrity: Proof derives each regime from exact flip-energy inequalities and finite cyclic counts. Standalone standard-library checker ran 195 exact tests. Finite tests do not replace the all-size proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts weak one-spin energy minima, not reached-state probabilities, mixing times, or finite-temperature lifetimes. Energy-neutral flips at resonant fields are permitted by the weak local-minimum definition. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent statements.
title: Magnetic-field collapse and critical enhancement of single-spin stability on antiferromagnetic wheels
